segments.name: organ transplant
segments.description: Sells OCS Heart, Lung and Liver perfusion systems with single-use disposable sets and provides outsourced organ procurement and transplant logistics services to US transplant centers.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations as a single segment for the purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions.

revenueModel.text: Transplant centers and hospitals pay for single-use organ-specific disposable sets used with each OCS transplant, for OCS Consoles, and for outsourced organ procurement, perfusion management and logistics services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates net product revenue primarily from sales of its single-use, organ-specific disposable sets used on its organ-specific OCS Consoles.
